$comment: SOURCE: the community 'best value attribute thresholds' sheet supplied by the repo owner
(2026-08-25), which names specific animation unlocks at specific ratings. Everything here traces
back to a line on that sheet; entries that go beyond it have been removed rather than invented.
This file is far less complete than badges.json — the sheet only lists the thresholds a creator
considered 'best value', not the full animation requirement table. Expect gaps.
`requires` uses the same clause format as badges.json: a list of AND clauses, each either

categories.name: Dunk Package
categories.description: Driving and standing dunk sets, including contact dunks.

categories.name: Jump Shot Release
categories.description: Shooting release, affecting speed and timing window.

animations.name: Normal Dribble Style
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Speed With Ball 40 -> Normal Dribble Style (good minimum for bigs)'.

animations.name: Good Dribble Animations (bigs / lockdowns)
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Ball Handle 71 -> Good dribble animations for bigs and lockdowns + decent signature moves'.

animations.name: James Harden Dribble Style
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Speed With Ball 75 -> Silver Lightning Launch + James Harden Dribble Style'.

animations.name: Extra Signature Dribble Animations
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Ball Handle 81 -> Silver Handles For Days + extra animations'.

animations.name: Best Layup Packages (Duren / Jokic / Trae)
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Driving Layup 80 -> Best layup animations (Jalen Duren, Jokic, Trae Young + more)'.

animations.name: Standing Dunk Animations (minimum)
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Standing Dunk 45 -> Minimum standing dunk animations'.

animations.name: Pro Standing Contact Dunks
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Standing Dunk 81 -> Pro Standing Contact Dunks + Silver Rise Up'.

animations.name: Contact Dunks
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Driving Dunk 87 -> Contact Dunks, Silver Posterizer, Air Space Takeover'.

animations.name: Pro Contact Dunks
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Vertical 75 -> Air Space Takeover, Pro Contact Dunks, Silver Posterizer'. The Driving Dunk half is inferred from the Driving Dunk 87 contact dunk line.

verification.notes: Vertical 75 is sourced; pairing it with Driving Dunk 87 is an inference.

animations.name: Key Jumpshot Releases
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Three-Point 80-85 -> Key jumpshots and badges unlocked'. The lower bound of that range is used.

verification.notes: Sheet gives a range (80-85) rather than a single rating; 80 recorded. Individual release requirements are not known.

animations.name: Extra Motion Styles
animations.notes: Sheet: 'Agility 80 -> Upgrades Silver Seatbelt to Gold + extra motion styles'.
